fieldValues.title: Budget
fieldValues.article_text: At most 10 delegated merges per cycle. The count resets at each cycle close (11:30 UTC at the current rhythm). Only the group's own delegated merges count: a group PR carrying gate:owner-merge does not. The builder also stops when delegated merges in the current cycle plus open delegated group PRs reach 10, and labels the issue needs-input. Going over budget is an escalation.
fieldValues.rationale: A cap keeps the output reviewable (reviewable units over throughput).
fieldValues.amendment_rule: Owner only: an amendment needs a new owner-ratified decision.
fieldValues.protected_status: Agent testimony until the owner ratifies the charter decision.
